scopeReview: CED FUN-3.F.1–2 repeated differentiation and higher-order notation. Uses prior chain, product, implicit and inverse-trig rules. No Taylor-series knowledge required from students; series are only separate QA corroborations. Radians and original domains checked.
varietyReview: Second derivative formula, exponential third order, trigonometric fourth-order cycle, logarithm, exponential product, given first derivative, implicit second derivative, first-but-not-twice differentiability, reciprocal third order, notation versus squaring and inverse-tangent second order.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
